scope_summary.description: Design-build replacement and upgrade of Direct Digital Control (DDC) / Building Automation System (BAS) across three occupied buildings at NAS Patuxent River, Maryland: B2187 (467,530 SF R&D facility), B2185 (268,000 SF office), and B2855 (49,464 SF office). Scope includes new BACnet-compliant DDC controllers, integration of existing CRAC units and VAV boxes, connection to base-wide Niagara 4.x UMCS network, cybersecurity implementation per DoD/NAVFAC requirements, performance verification testing (PVT), commissioning, and training. Buildings remained occupied throughout construction. Existing wiring reused where adequate. Government-furnished facility point of connection (FPOC) panels installed by contractor for B2187 and B2855.

clin_breakdown.CLIN_001_B2187: Replace/upgrade DDC system in 467,530 SF R&D facility; add CRAC units to new DDC; correct nuisance alarms; energy savings controls (OA resets, economizer, scheduling, chiller/boiler optimization); connect to base-wide Niagara network; install government-furnished FPOC panel.
clin_breakdown.CLIN_002_B2185: Replace aging Automated Logic DDC system in 268,000 SF office; add CRAC units; scheduling and optimization features; maintain existing base-wide network connectivity.
clin_breakdown.CLIN_003_B2855: Upgrade existing JCI Metasys DDC to meet current UFC standards; replace CO2, OA, and humidity sensors; clean heat exchange coils in RTUs and VAV boxes; TAB of HVAC system; commission new and existing HVAC systems.

existing_systems_B2187.AHUs: 15 variable-speed cooling-only AHUs + 27 constant-volume makeup AHUs
existing_systems_B2187.CRAC_units: 56 Pomona Air CRACs with hot water/chilled water coils and standalone DDC

technical_requirements.commissioning: UFGS 01 91 00.15 Total Building Commissioning required; independent CxA; HVAC and BAS systems
technical_requirements.pvt: Performance Verification Testing per UFGS 23 09 00; endurance testing; government-witnessed
